sentences.text: Shri Sourabh Singh Thakur - Advocate for applicant.
Shri Shailendra Mishra - Deputy Govt. Advocate for State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.407/2024 dated 08.10.2024 registered at Police Station, Nourazabad, District Umaria for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. The counsel for the applicant contends that the allegations levelled by the prosecution leave no iota of confusion, that the prosecutrix is a major and the prosecutrix as well as the applicant were in touch since August, 2023.
They started talking to each other and entered into friendship.

Therefore,
it is contended by the counsel that the allegations of commission of the offence subsequently, are baseless and merely an attempt to falsely implicate the applicant.

It is contended by the counsel that the applicant is in custody since 09-10-2024, charge-sheet in the matter has been filed and the applicant has no any criminal antecedent, therefore he deserves to be enlarged on bail.
3. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that the offence of rape has been committed by the applicant with the prosecutrix and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:61127 2 MCRC-52929-2024 no case for grant of bail is made out.
4.
Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

sentences.text:
5. On perusal of the record, prima facie it reflects that the prosecutrix as well as the applicant were in touch since August, 2023; they started talking to each other and developed intimacy;
subsequently it appears that an attempt has been made to implicate the applicant; and charge-sheet in the matter has already been filed, this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
